title: Barry Loudermilk comments on FAA legislation and political investigations
text:
Representative Barry Loudermilk, US Representative for Georgia's 11th District | Ballotpedia
Representative Barry Loudermilk, US Representative for Georgia's 11th District | Ballotpedia
Rep. Barry Loudermilk, who represents Georgia’s 11th district in the U.S. Congress, posted a series of statements on his official social media account addressing recent legislative actions and ongoing political investigations.
On July 22, 2025, Loudermilk commented on the passage of new aviation legislation, stating, "The Big Beautiful Bill, passed by @HouseGOP and Senate and signed into law, delivered the long overdue resources to bring the FAA into modernity."
A day later, on July 23, he addressed claims regarding Russian interference in the 2016 U.S. presidential election: ".@DNIGabbard has made public confirmation of what President Trump and Republicans have known to be true for years. President Obama knew that there was no Russian collusion in 2016, yet continued to push the narrative in an attempt to subvert the will of the people and a duly"
Later that same day, Loudermilk referenced his ongoing role in congressional investigations: "I appreciate Speaker Johnson entrusting me to continue this important investigation, and I look forward to working with Chairman Jordan and his team. It is vital that we continue to uncover the facts and begin the task of making needed reforms to ensure this level of security"
Barry Loudermilk has represented Georgia's 11th District since 2015 after succeeding Phil Gingrey. Before joining Congress, he served in both chambers of Georgia’s legislature as well as holding local party leadership roles. Born in Riverdale in 1963 and currently residing in Cassville at age 59, Loudermilk earned a Bachelor of Science degree from Wayland Baptist University in 1992.
